title: Frames and nested canvases
blurb: A canvas that draws other containers: two widget canvases inside a room, an email in an <iframe> on a drawn phone, a custom element that draws its children through an effect, an SVG diagram with a real button in each node, and a <script> element that draws a wheel from its own source text.
question: When a canvas draws a container (another drawable canvas, an iframe, a shadow tree, an SVG with foreignObject, a script element), does the content still draw, raise paint on the outer canvas when it changes, and take a tap where it was drawn?
result: Yes for all five in Chromium 157.
